knowledge:
- key_parameters:
    - type=Specifies the signature model type, either "Alexandrov" or "Shiraishi".
    - numBases=An odd integer specifying the length of the mutated sequence context (e.g., 3 or 5 bases with the mutated base at the center).
    - trDir=Logical indicating whether transcription direction should be taken into account.
    - refGenome=A BSgenome object used to extract flanking nucleotides of mutated bases.
    - transcriptAnno=A TxDb object used to obtain transcription direction when trDir is TRUE.
    - enforceUniqueTrDir=Logical; if TRUE, mutations mapping to overlapping genes with opposing transcription directions are excluded to avoid ambiguity.
    - normalize=Logical; for getGenomesFromMutFeatData, controls whether to output normalized fractions (required for decomposition) or raw counts.
    - minExplainedVariance=Numeric (0 to 1); if specified, identifies the smallest subset of signatures explaining at least this fraction of the variance.
    - greedySearch=Logical; if TRUE, performs a fast stepwise greedy search for signature subsets instead of evaluating all possible combinations.
    - method=Distance metric (e.g., "frobenius", "rss", or standard dist methods) used to compare signatures.
    - unique=Logical; if TRUE, mapSignatureSets performs a unique one-to-one mapping between signature sets.
- alternatives:
    - pmsignature=An external GitHub package mentioned for extracting Shiraishi-type signatures and MutationFeatureData objects. It must be used if converting directly from pmsignature objects, but decomptumor2sig can run independently using VCF/MPF files.
- when_to_use:
    - Use this package when you have somatic SNV data from individual tumor genomes (ideally with 100+ mutations) and want to estimate the exposure/contribution of known mutational signatures (COSMIC/Alexandrov or Shiraishi formats) to each tumor.
- pitfalls:
    - Applying signatures defined on whole-genome frequencies directly to targeted or exome sequencing data without adjustment. Use adjustSignaturesForRegionSet to normalize signatures to the target region's nucleotide frequencies.
    - Running decomposition on samples with too few somatic mutations (fewer than 100), which can lead to unreliable parameter estimation unless a highly restricted, tumor-type-specific subset of signatures is used.
    - Mismatching sequence context characteristics (e.g., numBases, trDir) between the input signatures and the preprocessed tumor genomes. Both must be processed identically.
    - Setting normalize=FALSE when extracting genomes from pmsignature objects for decomposition; raw counts should not be used for refitting.
    - Relying blindly on greedySearch, which can get stuck in local optima and fail to find the absolute best subset of signatures compared to an exhaustive search.

workflows.name: signature_refitting_and_quality_evaluation
workflows.intent: Decompose somatic mutations from individual tumor genomes into mutational signatures to estimate exposures and evaluate the quality of the decomposition.
workflows.stages:
1. Load the reference genome and transcript annotation databases.
2. Read and preprocess somatic mutations from VCF format into tumor genome mutation frequencies.
3. Read the mutational signatures from flat files.
4. Visualize mutation distributions and plot explained variance to determine signature subset thresholds.
5. Decompose tumor genomes to estimate signature exposures (contributions).
6. Re-compose/reconstruct tumor genomes from the estimated exposures and signatures.
7. Evaluate the quality of the decomposition numerically and visually.
workflows.code:
# load the reference genome and the transcript annotation database
refGenome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19
transcriptAnno <-
           TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene::TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene

# take the six breast cancer genomes from Nik-Zainal et al (PMID: 22608084) 
gfile <- system.file("extdata",
                     "Nik-Zainal_PMID_22608084-VCF-convertedfromMPF.vcf.gz",
                     package="decompTumor2Sig")

# read the cancer genomes in VCF format
genomes <- readGenomesFromVCF(gfile, numBases=5, type="Shiraishi",
                              trDir=TRUE, refGenome=refGenome,
                              transcriptAnno=transcriptAnno, verbose=FALSE)

# take the example signature flat files provided with decompTumor2Sig
sigfiles <- system.file("extdata",
                 paste0("Nik-Zainal_PMID_22608084-pmsignature-sig",1:4,".tsv"),
                 package="decompTumor2Sig")

# read the signature flat files
signatures <- readShiraishiSignatures(files=sigfiles)

plotMutationDistribution(signatures[[1]])

plotMutationDistribution(genomes[[1]])

plotExplainedVariance(genomes[[1]], signatures, minExplainedVariance=0.9,
                                    minNumSignatures=2, maxNumSignatures=NULL,
                                    greedySearch=TRUE)

exposure <- decomposeTumorGenomes(genomes[1], signatures)

plotDecomposedContribution(exposure)

exposures <- decomposeTumorGenomes(genomes, signatures)

isExposureSet(exposures)

computeExplainedVariance(exposures, signatures, genomes)

genomes_predicted <- composeGenomesFromExposures(exposures, signatures)

evaluateDecompositionQuality(exposures[[1]], signatures,
                             genomes[[1]], plot=FALSE)

evaluateDecompositionQuality(exposures[[1]], signatures,
                             genomes[[1]], plot=TRUE)

workflows.name: signature_adjustment_for_genomic_subsets
workflows.intent: Adjust and normalize mutational signatures derived from one genomic context (e.g., whole genome) to match the nucleotide frequencies of a target genomic region set (e.g., promoters or exome).
input: COSMIC mutational signatures (downloaded or read from package)
TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene (Transcript database to define target genomic regions)
workflows.stages:
1. Read the original mutational signatures.
2. Define the target genomic regions (e.g., promoters) as a GRanges object.
3. Adjust the signatures to the target regions using the reference genome sequence.
workflows.code:
# get Alexandrov signatures from COSMIC
signatures <- readAlexandrovSignatures()

# get gene annotation for the default reference genome (hg19)
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene::TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene

# get a GRanges object for gene promoters (-2000 to +200 bases from TSS)
library(GenomicRanges)
regionsTarget <- promoters(txdb, upstream=2000, downstream=200)

# adjust signatures according to nucleotide frequencies in this subset of
# the genome
sign_adj <-
   adjustSignaturesForRegionSet(signatures,
            regionsTarget, regionsOriginal=NULL,
            refGenome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)

workflows.name: mapping_and_comparing_signature_sets
workflows.intent: Compare and map two different sets of mutational signatures (even if they are of different formats or models) to find the closest matching signatures.
input: Nik-Zainal_PMID_22608084-pmsignature-sig1.tsv to sig4.tsv (First set of Shiraishi signatures)
workflows.stages:
1. Load the two sets of mutational signatures.
2. Compute distances between a single signature and a target signature set.
3. Map the signature sets to find the best matches.
4. Convert Alexandrov signatures to Shiraishi format or downgrade Shiraishi signatures to make different formats compatible.
5. Map the converted/downgraded signature sets.
workflows.code:
# get 4 Shiraishi signatures from 21 breast cancers from
# Nik-Zainal et al (PMID: 22608084)
sigfiles <- system.file("extdata",
                 paste0("Nik-Zainal_PMID_22608084-pmsignature-sig",1:4,".tsv"), 
                 package="decompTumor2Sig")
sign_s4 <- readShiraishiSignatures(files=sigfiles)

# get 15 Shiraishi signatures obtained from
# 435 tumor genomes from Alexandrov et al.
sfile <- system.file("extdata",
              "Alexandrov_PMID_23945592_435_tumors-pmsignature-15sig.Rdata", 
              package="decompTumor2Sig")
load(sfile)
sign_s15 <- signatures

determineSignatureDistances(fromSignature=sign_s4[[1]], toSignatures=sign_s15,
                            method="frobenius")

mapSignatureSets(fromSignatures=sign_s4, toSignatures=sign_s15,
                 method="frobenius", unique=FALSE)

sign_a <- readAlexandrovSignatures()
sign_a2s <- convertAlexandrov2Shiraishi(sign_a)

sign_sdown <- downgradeShiraishiSignatures(sign_s15, numBases=3,
                                           removeTrDir=TRUE)

mapSignatureSets(fromSignatures=sign_sdown, toSignatures=sign_a2s,
                 method="frobenius", unique=TRUE)
